narr: Scattered thunderstorms associated with low pressure moving along a frontal boundary produced heavy rain which caused flash flooding across portions of central and southeast Virginia.
ev: Lake Powell Road was impassable at Marclay Road due to flooding.
Portion of Goosley Road at Old Williamsburg Road was impassable due to water on the roadway.
Portion of Wythe Street at Route 142 (Halifax Street) was impassable due to flooding.
Interstate 95 at Exit 52 northbound was closed due to high water.
lsr: PORTION OF GOOSELEY RD AT OLD WILLIAMSBURG ROAD IMPASSABLE DUE TOP WATER ON THE ROADWAY. REPORT VIA SOCIAL MEDIA.
LAKE POWELL ROAD IMPASSABLE AT MARCLAY ROAD DUE TO FLOODING. REPORT VIA SOCIAL MEDIA.
